items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I don’t know why I always thought Alfred Newman did that, I used to get it mixed up with, “Street Song,” I guess, which was Newman's, or, “Street Scene.

ctx.x: I don’t know why I always thought Alfred Newman did that, I used to get it mixed up with, “Street Song,” I guess, which was Newman's, or, “Street Scene.” They all had that 30s New York sound.
